notes.title: First look at The Bunny Graveyard II
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LjUiGKL-vFk;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, here it is! Your first-ever look at The Bunny Graveyard II! Which you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2682980/The_Bunny_Graveyard_II/]add to your wishlist[/url] (for real this time) right now on Steam.

I'm sure you're all full of questions so, let's talk a little bit more about this new project.

[h2]The Story[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/79f0e6f07901fa594711b60a98e1ee7aebe24a23.png[/img]
The Bunny Graveyard II is [b]the second chapter[/b] of The Bunny Graveyard story. The story begins right after the cursor falls into a mysterious new world, where they meet the one and only, Skye the Bunny!

Skye the Bunny has a new mission now, to find her lost brother Claudio, who suddenly disappeared that night, along with many other of the residents in Carrot Town. Your job is to help Skye find her brother and discover the mystery behind all of these sudden disappearances.

[h2]New Characters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/32e9e86dcb97fce40ead139c136a50062fcfbced.png[/img]
As you can see in this reveal trailer, lots of new characters will be introduced, and all of them have voices too! Carrot Town is full of new people to meet, but not all of them are your pals. 

Who knows? Maybe some familiar faces will return as well...

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/50cc11b4319af53562941d8c83a749626102f855.png[/img]
This time, [b]the gameplay has evolved[/b], one of the many reasons why we're making it a full game rather than a smaller experience.

The big change? You play as Skye the Bunny. Unlike The Cursor, Skye can run faster, crawl, climb, and most importantly, jump. So, this game is part-platformer, part-survival horror. But don’t worry, Cursor fans! The Cursor is still here, letting you investigate objects with point-and-click gameplay from the first game. And that’s just the beginning, there are buildings to explore, bosses to escape from, a new collectibles system, more minigames and so much more. 

More details about the gameplay will be released as the year goes by, I will be sharing new trailers and clips from the game as we go further into development.

[h2]More Surprises To Come![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/903d4352e0416dc4328415eaeb19210ede00c81f.png[/img]
Even though the full game comes out next year, I want to let you know that there's plenty of stuff to look forward to this year!

[list]
[*] The demo of the first act is planned to come out at the end of this year, if everything goes well!
[*] We're working on a small secret game project for this year that we think you guys will love.
[*] The first game is still coming to more consoles!
[*] And whatever else we decide to cook up for the rest of this year!
[/list]

As always, thank you all for your patience and support, you guys are awesome and I really hope you liked the first look at the second chapter of The Bunny Graveyard! 

PS: We made [url=discord.gg/thebunnygraveyard]a new Discord server[/url] that you can join right now for those of you who want to meet the devs and talk to the community! We'll be doing some live Q and As about the game, and some cool events!

[url=discord.gg/thebunnygraveyard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/93b1275aa6e28f5878a8e92c16791a919ff7a960.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The BIG Update is here! Voice-Acting, Figurines, More Languages and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrate one year of The Bunny Graveyard with this new FREE update, available NOW![/h1] 
Well, maybe it's a bit too late to celebrate but... better late than never!

[h2]FULL VOICE-ACTING[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/e2e21df3e0484e87f2f78dcec4d60807094e531d.gif[/img]

For the first time ever, The Bunny Graveyard features [b]full voice-acting[/b]. Now you can replay the game and listen to all your favorite characters talk to each other. And guess what? Aside from adding voices, I also tuned-up all of the animations to add even more personality to the characters you all know and love.

[h2]FIGURINES[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/6cf1ddfb199d88557f2e8b7cc7aa7666bae4355a.gif[/img]

A new type of collectible has been added! FIGURINES are little statues of every single character that's been featured in the game, you can collect them all by purchasing them with you Bun-Buns. What are Bun-Buns you ask?

Bun-Buns are the game's currency [i][b](Don't worry, they're free)[/b][/i] you can get them by playing minigames and exploring around the levels to find Bun-Bun bags. You can also earn Bun-Buns by completing achievements! Complete an achievement and access the new in-game achievements menu to claim your prize!

[h2]NEW SCENES![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/7f4de1830412bd325d5e94591d61630c8ba783b4.gif[/img]

Some new animated cut-scenes have been added! I wanted to add these new scenes to the game to show how much I've improved and give you a look at what you should expect for the sequel! Hope you like them!

[h2]MORE LANGUAGE OPTIONS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/5b2b4726635c0aae2b2f286b0288f90c188a8cd5.gif[/img]

We got more languages now! You can now play the entire game in the following languages:
[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Swedish
[*] Polish
[/list]
[i]Keep in mind that the dub for the voice-acting is English-only![/i]

[h2]AND MORE![/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now adjust the game's audio volume
[*] New visual changes to the UI
[*] A new secret post-credit scene
[*] Improvements to the listening sections with hints added
[*] In-game achievements menu with prizes
[*] Tons of bug fixes
[*] And whatever else I added but forgot to put here because there's just way too many things in this update!
[/list]

[h2]A few words![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/5452fb4d09a6949fc7c2d832c40c64564a70b14c.png[/img]

I can't believe that after the long wait, it's finally here. Thank you all for your patience! I hope you enjoy this new update, while you wait for [b]The Bunny Graveyard II[/b]! I wanted to make this update to show my appreciation for your support the past year, without you guys, we would not be here right now, and I mean that! It's been a crazy ride, but REMEMBER, it has only just begun... Also, feel free to report any bugs you find in this update on the forums, I had to change lots of stuff to make it work with the Nintendo Switch port, but thankfully most of the nasty bugs we found were fixed in time. 

I want to give a quick shout-out to all the new and wonderful people who helped me make this update happen, because without them this game wouldn't be as awesome as it is right now:

[b]Additional Music:[/b] Damir-Ali Yusupov / Alidaster

[b]Voice Actors:[/b] Courtney Chu, Jason Norris, Aloysius Franklin, Laura Challender, Jesse Pinnick, Lanna Rose

[b]Additional Character Designs:[/b] Matthew Alvarez

[b]Localization:[/b] Active Gaming Media, Inc., Daniele ''Bollazza'' Bolis, Vignett, Manon Fauries, Daniel ''Zawdan'' Zawadzki, Łukasz Kontarski ''KiVio'', Lorenzo ''The SaruKage'' Irizarry Arana, Eueeeeeeeek, Felicia Almén ''EmoBeanie'', Erik_Spyro

[b]QA:[/b] Szymon Breński ''Brenia'', Mason Cowan, Luciano Sigilli ''Oswald'', Active Gaming Media, Inc.

That's it, have fun playing!

- Kenneth Alvarez "ElPichon"

notes.title: Gardener Skye Plushie! + The BIG update approaches...
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, partner! I'm a plushie now![/h1]

[previewyoutube=OlSaSUBcgQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out this limited edition Skye plushie, available now on Makeship! A lot of you were asking for a Skye plush so here she is, but remember! Since this is a Makeship plush, we're gonna need your help! If you can get us to [b]200 pre-orders[/b], she will be real! Otherwise, she will be consumed by the void and never to be seen in this earth EVER AGAIN...

If you want to keep supporting the development of this game, make sure to get one of these cute lil' plushies! It helps us a lot.

[h2][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/gardener-skye-plushie]You can get one here![/url][/h2]

Just look at her! She's so GORGEOUS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/f9fcb33692c23b534eea2b76bf689295c6256ddf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/3f66ddeb9bb25808eda1eae77e8dcc042fb4ecae.png[/img]

[h1]The BIG Update approaches...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/2c503b8fdad66d0766fb0d754f39b2bce92eec69.gif[/img]

The new The Bunny Graveyard update is coming this December! This will be the version that is currently available on consoles. This update includes the newly added voice-acting, improved animations, new collectibles, new languages and more! 

The update itself is pretty much done but for SOME REASON, it started bugging out on PC, so I need to take some time to fix these issues. But once I'm done with that, it'll release for free for everyone who owns the game currently. So stay tuned, cause the update could drop any day now...

[h1]Other stuff![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/ae6047f80c8f7c94b3a108af39f221faa5806005.png[/img]

I wanted to take this time and update y'all on the sequel! We're still working hard on it and we expect to [b]give you all a first look soon[/b], but for now... I'll stay quiet and just work on it. Once TBG II gets PROPERLY revealed I'm gonna go back to the usual development updates since I know you guys miss those, lol.

I know some of you might be worried since now I'm doing more console ports for the first game, but I just want more people to know about TBG! I think it's a great way to introduce TBG to more audiences and I also just love utilizing the console's gimmicks to make the experience more immersive. I'm never leaving PC behind though, after all this is where it all started! They're also not very hard to make, but they can be a liiiil' bit time consuming.

I've also just been very secretive about the sequel because I want to make sure it's done right, 'cause I'm not going to lie... the pressure is much higher than last time. I feel like I've improved so much over the years as an artist, programmer and maybe not so much as a musician but I'm getting there. I truly believe that TBG II is gigantic step up from the last, and I know you guys are gonna love it.

In the meantime, expect some ports, maybe some merch and some fun surprises that we're cooking up behind the scenes!

- Kenneth Alvarez "ElPichon"

notes.title: The Bunny Graveyard: Development Update [February 2024]
notes.content:
It's time for a new development update, we've been working on a lot of stuff behind the scenes so let's talk about some of it, shall we?

[h1]The Bunny Graveyard is coming to Nintendo Switch![/h1]

[previewyoutube=FqKiEo00uNM;full][/previewyoutube]

If you didn't know already, The Bunny Graveyard is on its way to [b]Nintendo Switch[/b]. But this port will not just be any normal port, the game will receive some enhancements and changes both visually and gameplay-wise. Including motion-controls, HD vibration and more!

But do not worry PC users, even though some [b]gameplay features[/b] will be exclusive to Switch, any content updates, improvements and future chapters will be released at the same time on all platforms. 


[h1]More languages![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/226e6f082252463df562298116ad959527deee7a.png[/img]

The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 1 is currently being translated to more languages, some of these are:

[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] French
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] ...and more!
[/list]


[h1]Boxers Plushie![/h1]

[previewyoutube=KuPvYVNjyAI;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably heard of this already, but yes! Boxers got himself his very own plushie, [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/boxers-plush]which is still available at the time of this writing[/url], however, this is a limited edition plushie so make sure to grab one before they're gone. As of right now, there's still 8 days left, so think about it! You guys absolutely CRUSHED that funding goal by the way, 450 sold so far!

We're definitely making another one... hehe.

This is also our first piece of merchandise and we're open to do more merch stuff in the future! But for now we'll only be choosing things that don't slow us down during development. So, if you got any requests for merch, let us know and we'll look into it!


[h1]NEW free content is coming this year...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/bb2ac8f9e73a7cd9b66e3e4b08aca012ab018319.png[/img]

We are working on a [b]new secret project[/b] for the game, it will be released as a free content update at the same time as the Nintendo Switch release. It's a small thing that we wanted to make for a while now, but never got the chance to do due to time constraints. Think of it as the next "4-1-1992" for now.

We'll be releasing a separate trailer for this soon, so stay tuned!

[h1]So... how's Chapter 2?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/cecbb68500a22edc235fba243ae8cc3fd205e136.png[/img]

Finally, let's have a quick talk about Chapter 2. 

We are still not ready to fully reveal Chapter 2, buuuut we can tell you a little bit about it. It is the most ambitious project we have ever done, we expect it to be about the same length as Chapter 1, but despite the length, this chapter has proven to be quite a challenge to develop... but you know us, we love ourselves a challenge! 

The story has been fully written, the gameplay has been finalized, but there's still quite a lot of programming to go, and don't get me started on all the music and animations left. Oh, did I also mention that this chapter will be releasing at the same time on Nintendo Switch and PC? And that it will also release in multiple languages? And that I'm still working on this game mostly by myself? 

Yeah, things are not the same as they were back when I was making Chapter 1, The Bunny Graveyard is no longer just a silly lil' indie game, but that's exactly what makes it fun. I seriously can't wait to show you guys what we've been working on, this chapter is going to blow you away. Expect a trailer sometime this year.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2227201/The_Bunny_Graveyard_Chapter_2/]You can add Chapter 2 to your wishlist now![/url]


[h1]Final Thoughts![/h1]

2024 is looking like an awesome year for this game, I'm hoping that this year we can get more people to know about this game.

I'm extremely thankful for all of the support that we've been getting lately, it's crazy that I can now FINALLY focus on this game full-time, something that I've been trying to do for a long time now. I'm still processing the fact that this game is coming to the Switch, but it really is! Truly a dream come true.

If you got any questions, ask in the comments and I'll try to answer as many as I can! And as always, thank you all!

- Ken "ElPichon"

notes.title: The final update approaches...
notes.content:
Hello! I wanted to apologize for the wait for 1.3.0, we were planning on releasing it this month but it's taking us a little bit longer than expected. The final update for Chapter 1 will be releasing sometime next month now, it will include localization support, as well as a Spanish version of the game and many other fixes.

I'm also aware of a big issue that has been affecting many players and it's related to the headphones sections. I realized that the engine we're using to make the game does not support audio device changes while in-game, that means you can't plug in your headphones while playing the game, you need to have them on before starting up the game or the audio will not play. Unfortunately I don't know how to fix this issue, so instead I will be completely reworking the headphones sections so they no longer require you to use your headphones.

Thank you for your patience.

- Ken "ElPichón"

notes.title: Upcoming Accessibility and Optimization updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Brace yourselves, cause [i]The Bunny Graveyard[/i] will be getting tons of updates next month![/h2]

We have decided that before we begin programming Chapter 2, The Bunny Graveyard will be going through some much needed final updates for optimization and accessibility. These are the things I'm currently working on for the next few updates:

[b]CONTROLS:[/b]
[list]
[*] The controls system will be completely reworked!
[*] The game will now natively support PS5, PS4, XBOX, Switch and more controllers.
[*] You will now be able to switch freely between keyboard controls and gamepad controls during gameplay. This means that the game will no longer disable keyboard controls when you connect a controller and vice versa.
[/list]

[b]LOCALIZATION SUPPORT:[/b]
[list]
[*] Although the game won't be getting any [b]official[/b] localizations anytime soon, I will now be adding support for localization. This means that all the game's text will be moved to an external file (probably a .csv) and it will now be easier to localize for the future.
[/list]

[b]OTHER STUFF I'M CONSIDERING:[/b]
[list]
[*] Brightness settings
[*] Audio settings
[*] Being able to adjust all settings from the pause menu so you don't have to go back to the main menu
[*] The game tells you where you left off when you enter the game menu
[*] Show all the achievements inside the game, this is so all future ports can support achievements and don't have to rely on achievement support.
[*] Skip cutscenes 
[*] Improvement of audio cues for deaf players.
[/list]

[h2]What other options or features do you think the game is currently missing and should be added now more than ever? [b]Give me your suggestions in the comments below![/b][/h2]

Oh and, if you want to help me test these updates, [url=discord.gg/pichongames]feel free to join our Discord![/url]

-Ken "ElPichon"

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions about The Bunny Graveyard
notes.content:
I've noticed there's been a lot of misconceptions/confusion around our plans for the game's future, so I want to take a moment to clear up some things that are being said:

[h3]Will the rest of the chapters be free?[/h3]

Every chapter releasing after Chapter 1 will NOT be free, however, there will be an option for you to buy them all early which is what we call the "[b]All Chapters DLC[/b]" This DLC is not available yet simply because we want to wait and see how long Chapter 2 takes to develop to give you guys a general idea of how long it takes for each chapter to release.

[h3]Will Chapter 1 ever be free?[/h3]

No, Chapter 1 was released as a paid product and will still remain as such, making Chapter 1 free would be unfair for previous players who already bought the base game. If a store ever approaches us with a deal to make the game free for a limited time, that's on them.

[h3]How long will each chapter take to develop?[/h3]

We would love to give you a clear answer on this, but the reality is that we don't know. Our team is really small at the moment, I, Pichon, do the programming, art, music, and almost everything about the game, and it is not an easy process. Chapter 1 took us almost a year to develop due a lack of organization and planning, but now that we actually know what we're doing, I expect later chapters to take us less time, but we'll just have to wait and see. 

[h3]Besides the "All Chapters DLC", will we be able to purchase chapters individually?[/h3]

Upcoming chapters will be released individually as separate applications, however if you want to receive them as updates, you must purchase the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2227200/The_Bunny_Graveyard__All_Chapters/]All Chapters DLC[/url]"

[h3]Will each chapter be $6.99 each?[/h3]

We currently plan on releasing every chapter for the same price as the base game.

[h3]Will the story of the game change depending on what players are saying?[/h3]

No, the game's story has been already planned in its entirety, we know what happens from here to the last chapter, and we will not be making any changes to the story throughout the development of this game.

[h3]When will Chapter 2 begin development?[/h3]

Chapter 2 has already begun development, In fact, we're actually 20% done already. Expect more news about Chapter 2 soon.

[h3]Will there be any post-game content?[/h3]

We have plans to expand the game in terms of post-game content, especially for replay value. We can't go into details yet, but expect more ways to replay the game later down the line.

[h3]Will the game release on consoles?[/h3]

It is something that we would love to do, but it's still in the planning stages, we will let you know if anything's confirmed.

[h3]Why does Skye look different in most of the promotional art for the game?[/h3]

Skye goes through a lot in this game, we know you have many questions about her and trust me, they will all be answered soon.

[h3]Will you ever make merchandise for the game?[/h3]

Merchandise is something that we're totally down for, but it's not something we're currently working on. We also don't want merchandise to slow down development time, so anything we end up doing must be something that takes us enough time to still work on the game.

[h3]Why did the game go through so many changes in pricing before release?[/h3]

While developing this game, we were still figuring out ways we could distribute it, in the past we've said a lot of different things we want to do but never said what we actually decided on. As someone who had not received any type of funding to develop this game, I was very uncertain about a lot of things, heck, I didn't even know if people would like this game when it released. You might find some old posts here or on different platforms of us saying the game will be released in a certain way or that it'll have this price or that, but I hope this post can clear all the confusion now. 

Again, I apologize for all the confusion, and I hope you look forward to the next chapter. Thank you all for your amazing support these past few days, we know this has only just begun, but I'm really happy with how everything has turned out. If you like this game, please spread the word to everyone you know that would like it too.

[h3]Have more questions? Ask in the comments below and I'll answer.[/h3]

[i]Edit: Due to limitations found with the game engine, we have decided to make a small change to our approach for releasing new chapters, so the fourth answer has been changed.[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1892420/view/3805038873992500463?l=english]More info about this change here[/url]

- Ken "ElPichon"

notes.title: The next step for The Bunny Graveyard
notes.content:
​

[h1]So, The Bunny Graveyard's DEMO just came out...[/h1]

...and it seems like no one played it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/da931cdd672d110e5497633cdc076684a03043e0.png[/img]

Yep... no one at all, not a single soul....

Ok, all jokes aside, I'm truly grateful for all of your support. It looks like a lot of you really enjoyed that demo! 😂

BUT it's time to get back to work, we have a game to make and a deadline to meet, so here's what we're planning to do and what we've learned so far.

[h2]Minigames[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/2ebc38b9dcf35e865fa8a0decbfd38445acd99d6.png[/img]

So after we released the DEMO, we received a lot of feedback! And we saw that some of our players found the minigames to be a bit frustrating, this is because some of them are based on pure luck, which is not really that good for something you need to do to make progress in the game, so we're working on improving them for the full version.

[h2]Finding Secrets[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/06d1ecc5e0a979008867ba6f04cf3cc12ff90d02.png[/img]

We noticed a lot of our players liked going back to see what happens when you pick other options and exploring to see if there's something hidden within the garden, and that's exactly what we're looking for.

We didn't have much time to add that many secrets to the DEMO, because we thought it would be better to leave them for the full game, so for those of you who want more of that, expect more dialogue options, collectables and secrets in the full release!

[h2]How do we get to this point in the story?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/cbcfff8f810c454b91229906651d9618dc004e58.png[/img]

This is a question we've been getting a lot! The footage in the trailers is a bit different from what the DEMO itself has shown and we are fully aware that Skye's appearance seems different too.

But don't worry, this question will 100% be answered in the first chapter... you'll just have to wait and see!

[h2]Episodic?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/d6d31c8e4cb854b6ff9f8236207e6ba3a524eb62.jpg[/img]

We know the episodic release sounds a bit strange, but we're fully committed to releasing every chapter 2-3 months after the last one. We know many games tend to take years to release a chapter, but trust me, we're NOT going to ever make you wait an entire year for a new chapter of The Bunny Graveyard.

Chapter 1 and 2 are already halfway done, and development is going smoothly so far... but just as a reminder, we're a team of only two people! So please have patience :D

[h1]Q & A[/h1]

We asked our members on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/V6fJsr5PMt]Discord Server[/url] to ask us any questions they had about the game, so here's some of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/a5577ad097ee8db96d59b5803ce8b44dfb33de1e.png[/img]

1.Each Chapter will have a different opening but the outro might get reused.
2.Puzzles will get a little bit difficult the more you progress, but not to the point where it's impossible.
3.Yes and no, some sprites are easy to make but the animated cutscenes take a while to perfect, especially with such a limited resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/33408b40643b812306242fba14ab5b238390d266.jpg[/img]

Absolutely! There are a ton of new characters we have yet to show.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/83ce2617700c1d78146534c9c69cf62689453434.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned before, yes, the game will release episodically first and we're already halfway done with Chapter 1 and 2, and the story for the next chapters has already been written.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/bae1d979b8c200a7e3a08cd9a09e2c90c7961187.jpg[/img]

It's hard to prove it, but we came up with the concept of The Bunny Graveyard by ourselves. We actually didn't know about Pony Island until now, and I can see some slight similarities but I wouldn't say they're the same thing. (Also, it looks like a good game btw I should play it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/8f94e64f10ba9766064b1c36da393169f33625b9.jpg[/img]

Yes, each chapter will have some drastic gameplay changes, HOWEVER, the top-down/point and click gameplay will stay throughout the entire game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41887806/3c4b8a88e3c75011db85f0e652967e8f77f45479.jpg[/img]

a LOT.

[h2]So, yeah that's about all the questions I could answer so far.[/h2]

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]

Finally, I wanted to say that we are aiming for a [b]Halloween release[/b], but if that's not possible, expect the game to drop sometime in [b]Early December[/b]. This is a big project, but unlike our previous ones, we know we are capable of finishing this one, and we have a lot of faith in it.

And one final thing I forgot to mention, it's possible that the game itself might not release under the [b]Early Access[/b] label, cause we think it doesn't really fit the game's status. Early Access is meant for unfinished games that might have bugs on them and are still in active development, but The Bunny Graveyard only has an unfinished story, the game itself will release in a stable state.​

Stay tuned to our social media accounts (@/pichongames on Twitter/Instagram or just here) where we'll be posting updates on development and important announcements regarding the game.

So yeah, I'm gonna stop talking and get back to work, if you read all of this, comment [b]I LOVE BOX![/b]

-[url=https://twitter.com/elpichonart][b]Ken[/b][/url]
